comparison.objective: Candidate configures a robot gripper; this record releases an air-fryer basket from its hot drawer and places it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs precision rotary counterholding; the record holds a release button while lifting by a cool handle and avoiding hot surfaces.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks angle retention and repeated motion; the record checks basket removal, safe placement, button return, release, stillness, and no hot contact, bypass, or drop.
comparison.reason: Button-held extraction under a thermal keep-out constraint is unrelated to screw adjustment and jam-nut locking.
